title: Orka.ai focused Groq regression — G041 G042 G046 G047 G049
note: Five-case regression batch covering aggregate aliases, country-level completed metrics, monthly grouping, category totals, and completed order values.

cases.question: What is the average quantity per order-item record?
cases.gold_sql: SELECT AVG(quantity) AS average_quantity FROM order_items;

cases.question: For each country, show the number of completed orders and completed revenue.
cases.gold_sql: SELECT c.country, COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) AS completed_orders, SUM(oi.quantity * p.price) AS completed_revenue FROM customers c JOIN orders o ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id JOIN order_items oi ON o.order_id = oi.order_id JOIN products p ON oi.product_id = p.product_id WHERE o.status = 'Completed' GROUP BY c.country ORDER BY c.country;

cases.question: Calculate the number of completed orders per month in 2025.
cases.gold_sql: SELECT DATE_TRUNC('month', order_date) AS order_month, COUNT(*) AS completed_orders FROM orders WHERE status = 'Completed' AND order_date >= DATE '2025-01-01' AND order_date < DATE '2026-01-01' GROUP BY DATE_TRUNC('month', order_date) ORDER BY order_month;

cases.question: Show the total quantity sold for each product category.
cases.gold_sql: SELECT p.category, SUM(oi.quantity) AS total_units FROM order_items oi JOIN products p ON oi.product_id = p.product_id GROUP BY p.category ORDER BY p.category;

cases.question: Calculate the total value of all completed orders for each order ID.
cases.gold_sql: SELECT o.order_id, SUM(oi.quantity * p.price) AS order_value FROM orders o JOIN order_items oi ON o.order_id = oi.order_id JOIN products p ON oi.product_id = p.product_id WHERE o.status = 'Completed' GROUP BY o.order_id ORDER BY o.order_id;
